summary.text: Rosalyn Henderson-Myers is a Democratic state representative from South Carolina House District 31 who has served since September 2017 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She is an attorney and the owner of the Henderson Law Group.

paragraphs.text: Henderson-Myers works as an attorney and owns the Henderson Law Group.
She was elected to the Spartanburg City Council in 2015.
She assumed office in the South Carolina House of Representatives on September 26, 2017.
Henderson-Myers advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026, defeating Mo Abusaft, 52.0% to 48.0%.
In the November 3 general election she faces James Jones of the United Citizens Party.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the House Judiciary Committee.
